essence: A hero seated on a corpse seat should recite the mantra eight thousand times.
Repeated cutting produces an alternating motion of going forth and being drawn back.
The mantra practitioner becomes accomplished in collyrium without any doubt.
By attaining contraction of desire, a man proceeds unimpaired.
A child may become eloquent or a swift poet.
